paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of FOCUS values across political leanings

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of three character roles—HERO, VICTIM, and VILLAIN—across different bias categories. The horizontal axis contains four categories labeled as "Left bias," "Left center bias," "Quest. source," and "Right bias," arranged from left to right, with no specific sorting order indicated. The vertical axis represents a range from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.2, indicating a linear scale of proportions or percentages with no specified units. Each category features a stacked bar divided into three color-coded segments: dark blue for HERO, brown for VICTIM, and light blue for VILLAIN. In the "Left bias" category, the HERO segment is approximately 0.3 in height, the VICTIM segment is about 0.1, and the VILLAIN segment roughly reaches 0.55. In the "Left center bias" category, the HERO segment is approximately 0.3 in height, the VICTIM segment is about 0.2, and the VILLAIN segment roughly reaches 0.45. In the "Quest source", the HERO category and VILLAIN category are of equal height and the VICTIM category height is of only 0.5. In the "Right bias" the VILLAIN category stretching to 0.6 height, whereas VICTIM only 0.1 and the HERO is 0.25.The bars in all categories show consistent heights for similar roles, with slight variations, particularly in the VICTIM segment's height. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their distinct color representation for each role. A legend is situated at the left side of the vertical axis labeling.
